    // Common separators that indicate the end of a parameter name
    return c == ' '  ||  // space
           c == '\t' ||  // tab
           c == '\n' ||  // newline
           c == '\r' ||  // carriage return
           c == ',' ||   // comma
           c == ';' ||   // semicolon
           c == ')' ||   // closing parenthesis
           c == '}' ||   // closing brace
           c == ']';     // closing bracket
}

private static boolean isParameterSeparator(final char c){
    return Character.isWhitespace(c)          // spaces, tabs, newlines
        || c == ','                          // comma separates parameters
        || c == ')'                          // end of parameter list or default
        || c == '('                          // start of an inline array initializer etc.
        || c == '='                          // default value separator
        || c == ';';                         // end of statement or other terminator
}
